'''2014 US Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 13–15 June 2014, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> Published lists are the Day 1 and Day 2 PDFs on the Players Committee decklist desk. Typed printouts on this page are [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] Day 2, [[Mike Tomashewski]] Day 1, and [[Brad Eier]] Day 1. Xerox Day 1 and Day 2 sheets from the same event are listed below as those scans are transcribed. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] is the published US National Champion.<ref name="winners">https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 13–15 June 2014
* '''Winner:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]
